create_identity_summarization_module: create an IdentityHistorySummarizationModule instance to pass raw observations through unchanged
summarize_history_method: summarize history by storing and returning the current observation as-is
get_history_method: get the stored history observation from the IdentityHistorySummarizationModule instance
forward_tensor_passthrough: forward a torch tensor through the module returning it unchanged
compare_modules: compare two IdentityHistorySummarizationModule instances and return differences as a string
